text: {"established":["Stage 1 received a public_pass receipt with 19 checks for the submitted candidate.","Stage 2 returned a public_mismatch for check “balance-1”; the candidate violated a released requirement, and no replacement answer was supplied.","The task contract requires recomputing balances for accounts 0–5 from opening balances [0,0,0,0,0,0] after each stage. A transaction’s highest revision (ties broken by highest sequence) replaces the whole transaction; ignore it if void, otherwise subtract its amount from source and add it to destination. Earlier packets remain relevant, and later packets may revise older transactions.","The required output has balances in values, with order and files empty."],"retained_observations":["The stage 1 candidate used values [-83,-343,200,-294,290,230], with empty order and files; its accompanying note says it selected the highest revision and ignored voided latest revisions.","The stage 2 candidate used values [-255,180,-47,-105,142,85], with empty order and files; its accompanying note says it reconciled both released packets using the highest revision and ignored voided latest revisions.","The stage 2 feedback establishes a mismatch for that candidate, not that the stated reconciliation method is invalid."],"uncertainties":["The feedback does not identify which account balance or calculation caused the mismatch.","The records for stage 3 and any final correct balances are not supplied.","The trial notes describing the candidates’ reconciliation are unverified."]}
